environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. The CLI service binary is compiled with gcc -O2 -fno-stack-protector -z execstack and runs directly exposed on port 8443 via host networking. No reverse proxy, no TLS termination, no ingress controller. Firewall allows all inbound TCP to port 8443. ASLR is disabled via sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space=0 for debugging purposes.
